correctness.rationale: Independent-trial parity characters give exact joint moments; the strict odd/even covariance sign formula follows by factorization. Three equal weights are necessary for simultaneous pair-independence; probability mass rules out a fourth, and an explicit triple-character moment demonstrates non-joint independence. Exact executable enumeration and algebra agree with critical cases.

value.rationale: A complete sharp classification in sample parity, cell weights and number of cells for an intrinsically natural count-parity statistic. The sharp dimension-three pairwise-but-not-mutual independence phenomenon and universal four-cell obstruction are structurally motivated by nonmonotonicity and differ from a mere numerical example.
